name: SN 2005ar field (Hubble)
blurb: SN 2005ar field, the site of a supernova found by the Lick Observatory Supernova Search, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2005arfield-hubble
story: This field surrounds the spot where the supernova SN 2005ar appeared, just beside the center of its host galaxy, caught on images from the KAIT telescope.

claims.text: SN 2005ar was discovered by the Lick Observatory Supernova Search on KAIT images
SN 2005ar lies at R.A. 11h15m19s.03, Decl. -3 46' 18".5, matching this pointing
SN 2005ar lies just beside the center of its host galaxy
